This natural amethyst geode cluster features deep purple crystals on one side and a rough, unpolished rock matrix on the other. The crystals show good clarity with a rich violet color and vary in size, displaying a layered structure transitioning from purple to clear and white at the edges. The specimen measures approximately 10-15 cm in length. It is in used but well-preserved condition with no visible damage or repairs. There are no manufacturer marks or branding, as this is a naturally occurring mineral specimen suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or as a decorative piece.

description:
Natural History Specimen
Petrified Wood Fossil
Ancient Mineralized Wood, Natural Earth Tones
This specimen of petrified wood represents a significant geological event where organic plant material was replaced by minerals, typically silica, over millions of years. The resulting fossil retains much of the original cellular structure and growth patterns of the source wood, now transformed into a dense, mineralized material. This particular piece features a unique, abstract form with a tapered, beak-like projection that lends it a sculptural quality suitable for diverse display environments.
Authentic mineralized petrified wood specimen with complex surface textures
Displays a range of warm reddish-brown and ochre tones characteristic of iron mineralization
Unique organic silhouette resembling an abstract avian form or skull
Measures 9 inches in length and weighs 1.22 pounds
Condition:
Good natural condition for a geological specimen. The piece features inherent natural irregularities, surface pitting, and textural variations consistent with the fossilization process. Some areas show smooth, dense mineralization while others retain a more fibrous appearance. No evidence of modern repairs or synthetic enhancements. Stable and suitable for shelf or cabinet display.

Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:

shipping.policy:
Shipping:
Shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). Orders will be shipped within
5 business days
(Monday-Friday) of payment. However, we make every effort to ship sooner. Shipping may be delayed in the event of unforeseen business closure for holidays, disasters, etc.
Our shipping software shops for the best shipping option for your order. The carrier that the item is listed with may not be the carrier with which the item(s) ship.
Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box, and we are contacted prior to payment. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Because of how our carriers charge for shipping, item weight is calculated based on the dimensional weight and not the actual weight of the item. This can potentially add to the shipping charge of combined orders if larger shipping materials are required.
Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.
You will need a physical street address to receive your packages.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
Attention:
Goodwill Middle TN is not responsible for lost or stolen packages after delivery to the customer has been confirmed with tracking information. Contact FedEx or USPS for further information.

description:
Rough and Polished Mineral Specimen Lot
Mixed Natural Stones
9.48 lbs
This substantial 9.48-pound collection features a diverse array of mineral specimens, ranging from raw, unrefined geodes to polished gemstones and cabochons. The lot includes a notable selection of quartz crystal clusters and points, bladed blue kyanite, and vibrant banded malachite. Ideal for collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, or as educational samples, the variety encompasses multiple geological formations and mineral species.
Mineral variety includes quartz, kyanite, malachite, amethyst, and jasper
Features rough geode pieces, polished tumbled stones, and one fossil specimen
Contains approximately 9.48 lbs of mixed material as shown in photos
Includes various textures from crystalline clusters to smooth river-worn surfaces
Condition:
Very good overall condition. The lot consists of natural stones and mineral specimens in their characteristic rough or polished states. Crystalline structures, such as the quartz points, appear largely intact with expected natural inclusions and edge wear. Polished stones show consistent surface finishes. Natural variations in color, shape, and internal fracturing are present across the collection as is typical for geological samples.

description: This lot contains assorted rough petrified wood and raw geode stone specimens. The collection features fossilized wood pieces with visible grain structure and coloration from beige to brown. Included are geode-like specimens with crystalline interiors composed of quartz or chalcedony. The stones vary in size, ranging from small to medium hand specimens. All pieces are in natural, unpolished condition with rough, uneven surfaces showing mineral textures and fossilized patterns. Ideal for collectors, educational purposes, or lapidary projects. No brand or model, as these are natural geological specimens.
